confirmed_stage.description: The stage token this gate asked about, written by `gate_state.py emit --stage`. Binds the answer to the profile it confirms: without it, confirming Seed and then rebuilding the same-run profile to Series A composed a clean Series A report against a gate that had never asked about Series A. compose refuses when this and stage_profile.detected_stage disagree.

answer_source.description: Who produced `answer`. Optional here because a gate that has not been answered has no source, and because an artifact written before this field existed is readable rather than invalid. `gate_state.py answer` requires it, and setup_run.py treats an answered gate without it as unauditable and re-asks. Observability, not provenance: the value is supplied by the same model that would self-answer.

history.description: Answered gates that were superseded within this run, oldest first. Append-only: `emit` carries the prior answered state forward so a decision cannot be erased by asking a different question. A `Stop review` anywhere in this run's history stays decisive.
